Hinge Pin Door Stop for Standard Weight Commercial Hinges

text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1513, Hinge Pin Door Stop

The Don-Jo 1513 Hinge Pin Door Stop keeps both walls and hardware safe without putting stress on the door, the door frame, or the wall. The hinge pin stop hits on the hinge leaf--that's why it doesn't need a rubber bumper! This type of door stop is also great for use on doors where a standard door stop just isn't possible such as where one door opens into another door. It is easy to install, just slide the hinge pin door stop on the pin of your standard weight commercial hinges before replacing the pin in the hinge. The 1513 Door Stop can be adjusted while installed for fine tuning. In fact, this Hinge Pin Stop allows the door to open up to 170 degrees, but you can adjust it to open as less wide if you want. Available in satin nickel, satin chrome plated, and oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Features and Specifications of the Don-Jo 1513 Hinge Pin Stop:

  • Works with commercial grade standard weight hinges.
  • Material: Cast Zinc
  • Overall Height: 1-1/32"
  • Hinge Pin Diameter: 3/8" or 5/16" with included Reducer Bushing
  • Opens to 170 Degrees or less.
  • Hinge pin stop hits the hinge not the door or the frame.
  • Easy to install.

Sold Individually
